facts.text: The {subject} build pipeline runs race detection before every merge.
The {subject} service keeps seven days of restorable database snapshots.
The {subject} production release window is Wednesday afternoon.
The {subject} frontend uses React and TypeScript and deploys to Vercel.
The {subject} security changes require approval from two reviewers.
The {subject} relational data uses PostgreSQL with WAL recovery.
The {subject} on-call engineer acknowledges critical alerts within fifteen minutes.
The {subject} runtime uses zero-call static memory when no Steward model is bound.
